thread.title: Microsoft's market cap jumps to within $4 billion of Apple's - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Microsoft's market cap jumps to within $4 billion of Apple's - MarketWatch
text:
Microsoft Corp.'s MSFT, +3.11% market capitalization climbed to within $4 billion of overtaking Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.47% as the U.S.'s most valuable company. Microsoft's stock rallied 2.0% in midday trade, lifting its market cap to $807.08 billion, based on 7,676,218,736 shares outstanding as of Oct. 19, according to the latest quarterly filing. Meanwhile, Apple's stock was down 0.8% to knock its market cap down to $810.94 billion, based on 4,745,398,000 shares outstanding as of Oct. 26. Most of Microsoft's recent strength relative to Apple has occurred since the end of October. Since then, Microsoft's stock has slipped 1.6% and its market cap has by $12.82 billion from about $819.9 billion, while Apple's stock has shed 21.9% and its market cap has declined by $227.64 billion from about $1.04 trillion. During that time, the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.31% has declined 2.5%. Microsoft could overtake Apple as the most valuable company if its stock rose 0.5% and Apple's stock did nothing, or if Apple's stock fell 0.5% while Microsoft shares did nothing.
